proof_body:
by
  intro a b c
  have key : a ^ 3 + b ^ 3 + c ^ 3 - 3 * a * b * c = (a + b + c) * (((a - b) ^ 2 + (b - c) ^ 2 + (c - a) ^ 2) / 2) := by ring
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h0 : (a + b + c) * (((a - b) ^ 2 + (b - c) ^ 2 + (c - a) ^ 2) / 2) = 0 := by
      rw [← key]; linarith
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h0 with h1 | h1
    · exact Or.inl h1
    · right
      have h2 : (a - b) ^ 2 = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - b), sq_nonneg (b - c), sq_nonneg (c - a)]
      have h3 : (b - c) ^ 2 = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - b), sq_nonneg (b - c), sq_nonneg (c - a)]
      exact ⟨sub_eq_zero.mp (pow_eq_zero_iff (by norm_num) |>.mp h2), sub_eq_zero.mp (pow_eq_zero_iff (by norm_num) |>.mp h3)⟩
  · rintro (h | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
    · have : a ^ 3 + b ^ 3 + c ^ 3 - 3 * a * b * c = 0 := by rw [key, h, zero_mul]
      linarith
    · ring
